args: Import-Module /opt/tools/binaries/arm-ttk/arm-ttk/arm-ttk.psd1 -ErrorAction Stop; $settings = @{}; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.arm-ttk.psd1') { $data = Import-PowerShellDataFile -LiteralPath '.arm-ttk.psd1'; if ($data.Skip) { $settings.Skip = @($data.Skip) }; if ($data.Test) { $settings.Test = @($data.Test) } }; $found = foreach ($file in $args) { $results = Test-AzTemplate -TemplatePath $file @settings 2>$null 3>$null 6>$null; foreach ($result in $results) { if ($result.Passed) { continue }; foreach ($e in @($result.Errors)) { [pscustomobject]@{ file = $file; line = $e.Location.Line; column = $e.Location.Column; rule = [string]$result.Name; level = 'error'; message = [string]$e.Exception.Message } }; foreach ($w in @($result.Warnings)) { [pscustomobject]@{ file = $file; line = $w.Location.Line; column = $w.Location.Column; rule = [string]$result.Name; level = 'warning'; message = [string]$w.Exception.Message } } } }; ConvertTo-Json -Compress -InputObject @($found)

governed.config: arm-ttk runs every test case unless the project's .arm-ttk.psd1 lists test names under Skip (or only those under Test): the project decides the test cases

suppressions.description: not honored: arm-ttk has no in-template suppression comments; the project skips test cases in .arm-ttk.psd1

en.label: arm-ttk (ARM templates)
en.purpose: The Azure Resource Manager template test toolkit: checks ARM templates for best practices such as unreferenced parameters, hard-coded locations and unsafe secrets.
en.limitation: It runs under PowerShell in the tools image, one template at a time, and picks .json files that mention schema.management.azure.com. It reads the project's .arm-ttk.psd1 (Skip and Test lists of test case names) when there is one; otherwise every test case runs.
en.needs: Nothing beyond the tools image (PowerShell and the toolkit are in it): no network and no project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: arm-ttk (templates ARM)
pt-BR.purpose: O kit de testes de templates do Azure Resource Manager: verifica boas práticas em templates ARM, como parâmetros sem referência, locais fixos no código e segredos inseguros.
pt-BR.limitation: Roda sob o PowerShell da imagem de ferramentas, um template por vez, e escolhe arquivos .json que citam schema.management.azure.com. Lê o .arm-ttk.psd1 do projeto (listas Skip e Test com nomes de casos de teste) quando existe; sem ele todos os casos rodam.
pt-BR.needs: Nada além da imagem de ferramentas (o PowerShell e o kit já estão nela): sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto.
